project_name: Cloud Kitchen Food Ordering & Delivery Management System
design_archetype: Organic Warmth meets Swiss Precision (Culinary High-Contrast)
theme_mode: Light mode default with dark slate navigation bars and warm high-contrast food accents

typography.font_rules: DO NOT use Inter for main headings. Use Plus Jakarta Sans or Outfit for bold personality. Use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for headings above 24px. Labels must be uppercase with tracking-[0.15em].

primary.description: Warm Saffron Amber / Flame Orange for main CTAs and food ordering action buttons

secondary.description: Deep Slate Navy for sidebars, primary navigation, and headers

accent.description: Soft peach tint for active tab highlights and pill selections

veg_green.description: Indian standard Vegetarian icon badge (Green square with green dot)

non_veg_red.description: Indian standard Non-Vegetarian icon badge (Red square with red dot)

admin_dashboard.layout: Desktop-optimized sidebar + top header navigation with drawer collapse for tablet/mobile
admin_dashboard.density: High density grid (MODE B) with stats cards, revenue charts, live order queue, and quick availability toggles

manager_dashboard.layout: Restricted permission responsive admin view focusing on kitchen fulfillment, menu toggles, and delivery assignments
manager_dashboard.density: Medium-high density KDS (Kitchen Display System) queue layout

customer_mobile_app.layout: Mobile-first view with sticky category filter header, food cards, sticky bottom cart bar, sheet drawer for cart/checkout, and map-based tracking view
key_rules: Unavailable items MUST remain visible in the menu but styled with reduced opacity (opacity-60), a prominent 'Currently Unavailable' badge, and a disabled Add-to-Cart button
Order status stage shown to customer MUST strictly use 3 stages: 'ORDER BEING PREPARED', 'ORDER ON THE WAY', 'ORDER ARRIVED'
Address system relies ONLY on GPS coordinates / OpenStreetMap pin selection (no manual street text standard address fields required)
Delivery Fee = ₹0, Platform Fee = ₹0, Convenience Fee = ₹0. Total = Item Total only
Payment mode = Cash on Delivery (COD) only
Delivery radius limit = 5km maximum from kitchen GPS location with instant validation

delivery_partner_mobile_app.layout: Mobile-first interface with Active Delivery view, Kitchen to Customer Leaflet route map, action workflow buttons (Accept -> Pickup -> Start Delivery -> Delivered), and Earnings/History tab
key_rules: High-contrast large touch targets (min 48px height) for quick action while on motorcycle/scooter
One-tap map navigation launcher and delivery status stepper

leaflet_map_guidelines.map_container_height: Mobile tracking: min 300px height or flex-1 full screen. Admin live map: min 500px height
leaflet_map_guidelines.radius_circle: Render a transparent red/amber 5km radius circle around the central kitchen location

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill or rounded-lg with explicit hover states, transition-colors duration-150. Always use explicit text color on hover.
component_guidelines.cards: Subtle border (border-slate-200), shadow-sm, hover:shadow-md transition-shadow. No extreme gradients.
component_guidelines.veg_non_veg_badge: Square 16x16px with rounded-sm border 1.5px (green or red) containing a centered solid dot 8x8px (green or red).
component_guidelines.sticky_cart_bar: Fixed bottom-4 left-4 right-4 bg-slate-900 text-white p-4 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between shadow-xl z-40

avatars.description: Delivery courier rider in helmet with delivery bag

general_ui_ux_guidelines.test_ids: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, status badges, and cart items MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='menu-add-to-cart-button', data-testid='checkout-place-order-button', data-testid='order-status-badge').
general_ui_ux_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure high-contrast colors (min 4.5:1 ratio for normal text). Do not rely on color alone for critical status; always pair colors with text labels and icons.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.responsiveness: Admin/Manager views MUST work smoothly from desktop (1280px+) down to tablet (768px) and mobile drawers. Customer & Delivery Partner views are mobile-first (max-w-md mx-auto centered frame on desktop).
general_ui_ux_guidelines.toast_notifications: Use sonner for notifications (order updates, stock toggles, delivery assignments).
